why: A (universe 0) is proposition_16_3_16_two (the printed statement: reflexive 1-fibres, reflexive auxiliary norm n, y_k mixed convergent to y in some model, n(y) ≤ liminf n(y_k) in EReal) together with mixedTendsto_iff_forall (model independence of Definition 16.3.14) and proposition_16_3_16_two_of_mem (the inequality with mixed convergence read in one structure S in which n is represented by a reflexive auxiliary norm). B is the main conjunct with the extra hypotheses y_k, y ∈ Y01; these follow from mixed convergence (the representatives give y_k = Γ(|w_k|)), so B and the main conjunct are equivalent. The two side conjuncts do not follow from B (one is about the notion only; the other has no hypothesis ⟦S⟧ = c with reflexive 1-fibres, so B does not apply); they are re-proved outright from non-item lemmas (mixedTendstoIn_of_equiv, HasReflexiveFibers.of_mem, theorem_12_2_11_exists, the le_liminf field). They are proof-level variants, not extra content of the proposition.
